text: ポケモンにも　その　わざを　おしえるって　いうぜ！

structure.jp: その　わざを　おしえるって

patterns.name: 〜という
patterns.span: おしえるって　いう
patterns.explanation: という after a statement means 'they say that', for something heard from others. って is the casual form of と. おしえるって いう = 'they say he teaches it'.

patterns.name: 〜ぜ
patterns.explanation: ぜ at the end is a rough, manly way to push a statement at the listener. いうぜ = 'they say, you know!'.
